text:
harper_se: FYI - Solaris procurement asked for a short SIEM/audit evidence packet for their vendor risk review. POC next week. They want admin events, detection samples, forwarding options (Splunk/Syslog/S3), retention numbers, and immutability details.

jo_security: I'll draft a compact packet. Map to SIG/CAIQ: auditability -> CAIQ.AUDIT, monitoring/forwarding -> SIG.MON, retention/immutability -> SIG.RET.

harper_se: Keep examples single-line JSON so procurement can copy/paste. Also they asked if we support customer KMS and Object Lock.

jo_security: Yes to both. Customer can provide S3 ARN + KMS key; we write gzipped ndjson and can set Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode.

jo_security: Admin event example:
{"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2026-02-12T15:10:22Z","actor":"u_210","action":"change_quota","target":"proj-99","req":"req_320"}

jo_security: Detection example:
{"event_type":"detection","ts":"2026-02-12T15:12:05Z","name":"suspicious_api_pattern","sev":"medium","count":18}

harper_se: Tiny forwarder snippet for ops team (curl -> Splunk HEC):
curl -s https://splunk.solaris.local:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log

jo_security: Retention defaults (Hosted): API logs 90d hot / 13mo cold; Admin/audit 1y default (optional archival up to 7y to customer S3 with Object Lock); Auth events 13mo; Inference metrics 90d. POC: we can extend to 6 months by config.

jo_security: One-line security note: "Logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS supported for S3 archival. Audit log access is RBAC-restricted and access itself is logged."

ops-bot: POC instance scheduled: solaris-poc at 2026-02-15T02:00:00Z.

harper_se: I'll send this with a one-page mapping to SIG/CAIQ and attach these two examples. If they request network allowlist or mTLS we'll follow up with egress IP ranges and mutual TLS options.

jo_security: If they need a formal immutable retention SLA, mark as Dedicated/Private add-on and loop legal.

harper_se: Sent to Solaris procurement at 2026-02-12T16:00:00Z. Marking resolved unless they come back with additional asks.
